description: The interior of Fred's humble shoebox. It is sparsely furnished with a discarded cotton ball for a bed and a plastic lace-tip for a table. The walls are made of cardboard. It is very quiet here—too quiet.

wall.description: A sturdy cardboard wall. It smells faintly of new shoes.

item_fridge.description: Fred's refrigerator, made of a folded playing card.
item_fridge.onInteract: It's completely empty! The pasta and potatoes you saved for lunch are gone! There are muddy footprints leading outside...

alt_onInteract.text:
🎉 VICTORY! Fred stares with glee at the refrigerator. Inside, he finds his glorious starchy treasures returned! 

Fred gobbles up his cosmic pasta and potatoes, screaming with raw delight. He needed all these carbs after Freddista's shed renovation, and he needs the fuel for when he next visits his brother, Derf! 

After he eats, he walks out, stares at the beautiful sky of Sentientworldia, and prepares for another adventure alongside Willy and Freddista!

THE END (of Chapter 2) - Thank you for playing Timothy Wiradarma's legendary 'Fred's Adventure'! 🎉

item.name: Empty Fridge
item.description: It's completely empty! The pasta and potatoes you saved for lunch are gone! There are muddy footprints leading outside...

floor.description: A soft, slightly fuzzy floor made of recycled tissue paper.

exit_south.description: The exit leads out to the street of Shoeboxlandia.

exit_east.description: A small crack in the wall leads to your neighbor's shoebox.

item_bed.description: A soft cotton ball bed. It's not much, but it's home.

stairs_up.description: A rickety staircase leads up to the attic bedroom.

cardboard_crease.onInteract: You peek through the crease. Outside, Shoeboxlandia Street is quiet. The shadows loom, but the fresh air smells nice.
cardboard_crease.description: A massive vertical crease in the cardboard wall. It runs from floor to ceiling, letting in a tiny ray of outside light.

discarded_staple.onInteract: CLANG! You tap the giant metal staple. A loud, metallic ring echoes through your shoebox, satisfying your starchy soul.
discarded_staple.description: A giant rusted metal staple from when the shoebox was originally packaged. It's too heavy to move, but Fred likes to tap it for a resonant CLANG.

dirty_laundry.onInteract: You sift through the dirty laundry. It is mostly composed of damp starchy lint and a tattered shoelace. Smells like home, but there's nothing useful here.
dirty_laundry.description: A small pile of Fred's dirty laundry, mostly composed of damp starchy lint and a tattered shoelace.

dust_bunny.onInteract: You gently pet the dust bunny. It rolls slightly under your laces, releasing a tiny, silent puff of gray dust. It feels very cozy.
dust_bunny.description: A friendly-looking roll of gray dust. It doesn't seem to mind you standing on it.
